The three largest banks in the world are secretly creating something that goes against their 10-year stance on Bitcoin. And they aren't doing it for their clients — it's for themselves.

There's a number in the Bitcoin market that's telling them exactly what's coming, and they want to control the infrastructure before the world catches on.

In this video, I walk you through what they're building, show you that number, and what it means for your Bitcoin.

You'll learn:

→ Why Citigroup is integrating Bitcoin into the same framework as US Treasuries — and what that means for the future of institutional finance

→ The Morgan Stanley 180° flip: from calling Bitcoin "potentially worthless" in 2017 to launching an ETF that undercuts BlackRock on fees in 2026
→ The Amy Golenberg quote that reveals what Wall Street is REALLY doing — "We need to build this internally. We can't just rent the technology."

→ The 40-to-1 ratio that breaks every model on Wall Street — $3-4 TRILLION in projected institutional Bitcoin demand vs. only $77 billion in new supply over the next five years

→ Why Bitcoin isn't just surviving Iran and Venezuela — it's the only asset that passes the test no other asset can pass

→ The supply math that's already happening RIGHT NOW — public companies added 47,000 BTC in March 2026 while miners produced only 13,950

→ Why central banks just quietly switched from buying gold to SELLING it — and what that tells you about the crisis they believe is already here

→ The 1971 moment we're living through — and why this time, Bitcoin is the escape hatch gold could never be
